decisions.reason: The source explicitly changes the basket-weave print, but its existing same-message MODIFY already captures the 5 cm scale, brushed-brown tone, reduced contrast, added grain and texture, faded edges, and softer lived-in finish. No additional update or removal is required.
The phrase 'both prints' refers to the zebra and basket-weave prints discussed in the message, not the deferred mustard block-colour pareo.
The source gives refinement instructions only for the zebra and basket-weave prints and does not change the deferred terracotta block-colour pareo.

The source changes the visual treatment of the zebra and basket-weave artwork but does not alter the production-ready delivery standard, print method, target fabric, colour-matching workflow, or ICC-profile requirement.
